values.en: Proof of the Normal Differential Formula

Differentiate $\langle\boldsymbol N,X_j\rangle=0$ in coordinate $i$: $-\langle\partial_i\boldsymbol N,X_j\rangle=\langle\boldsymbol N,\partial_iX_j\rangle$. For $i,j=1,2$ these four entries are $e,f,f,g$, using equality of mixed partials. Since $d\boldsymbol N_q(a,b)=a\boldsymbol N_u(q)+b\boldsymbol N_v(q)$, bilinear expansion gives $eac+f(ad+bc)+gbd$.
values.zh-CN: 对 $\langle\boldsymbol N,X_j\rangle=0$ 沿第 $i$ 坐标求导：$-\langle\partial_i\boldsymbol N,X_j\rangle=\langle\boldsymbol N,\partial_iX_j\rangle$。对 $i,j=1,2$，利用混合偏导相等，这四个值依次为 $e,f,f,g$。又 $d\boldsymbol N_q(a,b)=a\boldsymbol N_u(q)+b\boldsymbol N_v(q)$，双线性展开即得 $eac+f(ad+bc)+gbd$。
